ios.desc:
Make your iPhone truly yours—customize your Lock Screen, Home Screen, and Apple Watch with 17,000+ wallpapers, widgets, themes, and AI-powered designs.

What is MyScreen? 
MyScreen is the ultimate iPhone personalization app, trusted by over 50 million people. Want a custom look for your phone that nobody else has? MyScreen makes it easy. Browse a massive library of 4K wallpapers, apply animated wallpapers, customize widgets and icons, design Apple Watch faces—all in one app.

Why do millions choose MyScreen? 
Most wallpaper apps offer a static gallery. MyScreen is a full personalization studio that combines a massive, weekly-updated wallpaper library, live wallpaper engine, AI image generator, widget customization, icon packs, and Apple Watch face design. One tap––perfect fit, every time.

What can you do with MyScreen? 
— Browse thousands of high-resolution wallpapers across categories such as Nature, Anime, Abstract, Neon, Urban, Minimalist, Cars, Dark Mode, and more—with new designs added every week.
— Set animated live wallpapers with seasonal and trending collections updated monthly. 
— Generate unique AI wallpapers and avatars, exactly as you want them. Type a prompt and get a design no one else has.
— Style your Home Screen with custom widgets and icon packs for a fully cohesive aesthetic layout.

KEY FEATURES

LIVE & 4K WALLPAPERS LIBRARY
Explore thousands of high-resolution wallpapers and animated live wallpapers from landscapes and abstract art to neon patterns and anime.

AI WALLPAPER & AVATAR GENERATOR
Describe what you want and let AI create it. Custom wallpapers and avatars no one else has. Just type a prompt and export.

ONE-TAP OPTIMIZATION & INSTANT APPLY
Every image auto-adjusts to your exact screen dimensions. No cropping, no resizing. Set to Lock Screen, Home Screen, or both in one tap.

WIDGETS & ICON PACKS
Customize interactive widgets and swap icon packs for a fully themed Home Screen aesthetic.

APPLE WATCH FACES & STANDBY MODE
Custom watch faces and iOS 17+ StandBy screens—extend your style to every Apple device you own.

How It Works 
1. Browse our library of backgrounds, live wallpapers, themes, widgets, and watch faces.
2. Tap any design to preview it on your Lock Screen, Home Screen, or Apple Watch.
3. Want something original? Open the AI generator, type a prompt, and get a custom wallpaper in seconds—auto-optimized, no cropping needed. 
4. Apply instantly or save to Photos. The whole process takes under 10 seconds.

search “wallpapers” in the app store and try the top results: 
1. 188k reviews, 4.99/week https://apps.apple.com/us/app/live-wallpapers-for-me/id1069361548
2. 120k reviews, 4.99/week https://apps.apple.com/us/app/live-wallpapers-for-me/id1069361548
3. 243k reviews, 4.99/week https://apps.apple.com/us/app/wallpapers-widgets-myscreen/id1039845801

Tricking users into these high priced subscriptions is a tried and true strategy in the app store. The press caught on late (2018) but it was happening from the moment apple opened up subscriptions to all developers in June 2016. Started with crappy coloring book apps and then spread like wildfire from there. Bending Spoons is simply the evolution of that.

https://techcrunch.com/2018/10/15/sneaky-subscriptions-are-plaguing-the-app-store/
